changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Nym') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Nym]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](25) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, [Name] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [PredicateID] [int] NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Nym_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_Nym_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NOT NULL, [Visible] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_Nym_Visible] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_Nym] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_Nym_Predicate') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Nym] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_Nym_Predicate] FOREIGN KEY([PredicateID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[Predicate] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[Nym] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_Nym_Predicate] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Nym_Visible') BEGIN CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_Nym_Visible] ON [dbo].[Nym] ( [Visible] ASC ) END
